title: Create Colonies
description: A small minecraft create mod citybuilding modpack.
body:
Create Colonies is a modpack built around create aeronautics. It is made for a fun **citybuilding** experience, but can also be used for normal survival or creative gameplay. 

Important mods included are **Create**, Create Aeronautics, **Farmers Delight**, CC: Tweaked (computercraft), Sophisticated Backpacks and a lot of Create Addons.

For block variation there are Create copycats addons and the mod Chipped, which provides a lot of different block variations for already existing blocks.
